extensions._comment: Writes every broker event to syslog: connections, subscriptions and publishes, one line each. Declares XMQ_CAP_OBSERVER, so it is never asked whether a client may connect. 'ident' is the name syslog tags the lines with, 'facility' is where they land - user, daemon, or local0..local7, which is what an administrator has to separate this broker's lines from everything else.
extensions.name: event_logger
